inputs.text: [dry, precise, fussy, deadpan] Wonderful. Now I'll need evidence... of the evidence.
[misty-eyed, moved, voice cracking] The evidence... it was all there.
[misty-eyed, moved, voice cracking, after a pause] I don't know what to do with my hands.

voice.name: Grampa Werthers - Old & Cranky
voice.about: Sometimes sweet, always honest. American old timer who remembers how the world used to be. A grumpy grandpa, or a wise elder male storyteller for silly old-fashioned parody, cartoon or comedy content. A funny grandfather character voice by Hey Its Brad.
